hero.deck: I investigate how molecular interfaces, defects, and ionic dynamics shape charge transport and persistent electronic states. My work connects perovskite memory, neuromorphic devices, and optoelectronics with the question of how emerging devices can operate reliably.
hero.affiliation: Integrated M.S.–Ph.D. researcher · School of Electrical Engineering, Korea University

research.title: Research
research.foundationText: Organic, hybrid, thin-film, and flexible electronics underpin this device-physics research.

about.title: About
about.text: Min Jong Lee is an integrated M.S.–Ph.D. researcher in electrical engineering at Korea University. His first-author work connects molecular interfaces, optoelectronic devices, and emerging memory.
